flagship_projects.name: Luxury Residential Portfolio – Gurgaon
key_points: Partners with top developers like Emaar India, DLF, M3M, Godrej, and Paras Buildtech
Focuses on new-launch and resale luxury apartments in prime Gurgaon micro-markets

flagship_projects.name: Dubai International Listings
key_points: Expanded international footprint offering properties from Emaar, Sobha, Nakheel, and Tiger Group
Targets NRI and HNI investors seeking cross-border luxury assets

market_position.positioning_summary: Search My Property is a mid-sized boutique real estate consultancy headquartered in Gurugram, positioned as a trusted, customer-first advisory for luxury and premium segments in NCR and Dubai. Founded in 2011, they emphasize transparency, end-to-end service, and over a decade of market experience. They cater to both investors and end-users, differentiating on personalised service over scale.
differentiators: End-to-end service covering buying, selling, leasing, loan assistance, and interior support
Over 2,700 satisfied customers with a team of 38+ professionals averaging 20+ years of combined experience
Active cross-border presence covering Gurgaon, Delhi, Noida, Goa, and Dubai
risks_or_weaknesses: Small team of 11–50 employees limits scalability compared to large portals like 99acres or MagicBricks
Limited brand visibility and digital content depth compared to tech-driven proptech competitors
Website and digital assets appear relatively basic, potentially reducing organic lead generation

instagram.typical_content: Property listings, project showcases, and locality highlights across Gurugram and Dubai. Also manages a secondary handle focused on resale and rental.
instagram.engagement_quality: Moderate following of ~6,000 with 827 posts; engagement per post appears low relative to follower count.

linkedin.typical_content: Company updates, property market insights, and team highlights.
linkedin.engagement_quality: Small professional audience; engagement data not publicly available.

industry_trends.segment: luxury and premium real estate consultancy – Gurgaon / NCR / Dubai
key_trends: Rising NRI and HNI demand for luxury properties in Gurgaon and Dubai is driving cross-border consultancy growth
Proptech platforms and AI-powered listing portals are raising the bar for digital UX, pressuring boutique agencies to upgrade their online presence
Video-led marketing and virtual property tours are becoming standard for luxury segment outreach on Instagram and YouTube
Hyper-personalised advisory services are gaining traction as buyers seek trusted consultants over self-serve portals

comparison_to_competitor.summary: Square Yards is a well-funded, tech-enabled real estate platform with strong digital infrastructure, international offices, and a broad developer network, making it a formidable competitor in the same NCR and Dubai luxury segments. Search My Property competes on personalised boutique service and local expertise but lacks the marketing scale, brand recall, and tech investment of Square Yards. Square Yards' website and social presence are significantly more advanced, offering data-driven tools and high-volume content.
notes: Square Yards operates in 20+ cities and 9 countries vs. Search My Property's 4–5 markets
Other strong competitors with good websites include 99acres.com, housing.com, and nobroker.in, all offering richer search UX and higher traffic volumes
